visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a metal ladle stirring a steaming, dark brown thick soup in a large industrial pot. A female worker wearing purple rubber gloves and a blue apron is seen preparing the food at a traditional stall. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the steam rising from the pot. (2) A bowl of meat thick soup (rou geng) is shown in a medium close-up, topped with fresh green cilantro. A metal spoon lifts a chunk of pale, seasoned meat from the translucent broth. The setting is a casual outdoor dining area with metal tables. (3) The camera focuses on wavy science noodles being lifted from the thick soup with chopsticks, demonstrating the texture and how the sauce coats the noodles. The background is slightly blurred, emphasizing the food. (4) A red plastic spoon is used to sprinkle bright orange chili powder over a bowl of noodles. The bowl sits on a metal table next to other plates of food. The camera angle is a high-angle close-up. (5) A bowl of dry noodles topped with minced meat sauce, sprouts, and green onions is shown. Chopsticks toss the noodles to mix the sesame sauce. The worker's hands in purple gloves are visible in the background as she works. (6) A plate of sliced braised delicacies (lu wei) including tofu, eggs, and pork ears is presented with a thick brown sauce and scallions. Chopsticks pick up a translucent piece of pork ear. (7) The final scene provides a wide shot of the storefront named '無名肉羹麵店' with customers seated on plastic stools under a red awning. Yellow text overlays provide address information and brand social media handles.
